title: Roles and permissions (RBAC)
summary: Who may do what: roles hold permissions that modules declare, users hold roles. Fills the kernel's d.Authz; Roles page with a per-module permission editor and members; Administrator role with every permission.
when_to_use: Different people need different access: admins, staff, read-only viewers.
Any app with more than one kind of user, once auth is in.
when_not_to_use: Every signed-in user may do everything — without rbac that is already the policy.
Access that depends on the record itself (only your branch's invoices): rbac grants per action, not per row — build that in the module that owns the data.

ports.name: UserDirectory
